items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:91:1
items.html: The light that was taken from these ten Ketarim in every Partzuf, etc., is the secret of the supernal splendor that was taken from Adam HaRishon: As explained in the adjacent item, that besides the nine lower ones of the vessels and the nine first ones of the lights that were lost in general, even in the Ketarim that remained in him the nine first ones of the lights are likewise missing, which are Ruach, Neshama, Haya and Yechida in each Keter of the hundred Ketarim that remained in him. However, there is a great difference between these two losses, for the nine first ones of the lights in general, and those of the Ketarim, that were lost to him did not fall into the Klipot [shells], but departed upward to their root, until Enoch came and took them back, as the ARI writes further on. But the nine lower ones of the vessels that were lost to him fell into the depths of the Klipot, and their correction will not be completed until the coming of Mashiach Ben David.
